_comment: Lithero working scope - WILDCARD ENABLED at the hunter's direction.
The published terms do not enumerate assets and carry no safe harbor, so
this breadth is a judgement call, not something the policy grants. See
POLICY-NOTES.md. scope.conservative.json is the cautious alternative.
Terms section 1 excludes third-party services. recon.py resolves every
name's CNAME before sending it any request: hosts pointing at SaaS
products are written to out/third-party-subdomains.txt and skipped unless
--probe-third-party is passed. CDN edges (CloudFront, Akamai, Fastly)
are treated as the target's own app and probed normally.
